name: Verdurous-Pingo
description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the west, tectonic rift valleys. Nothing wears any of it smooth.
No wind, no voice, no weather: the landscape communicates in light and shadow alone, and it has plenty to say at sunrise.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
